criteria.dimension: Plan completeness across the three parts

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One part (contacts, records, or urgency rule) is missing or minimal.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All three parts are present and each reflects skills built earlier in the unit.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The three parts are consistent with each other (for example, the record-keeping section says where the same contact info from part one would be found).

criteria.dimension: Appropriate level of detail (role and location, not real private detail)

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: At least one entry lists something closer to a real private detail than a role and location.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Every entry uses a role-and-location format with no real private detail.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The format is also specific enough that a guardian could act on it immediately, not just generic.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Guardian confirmation is a blanket checkmark with no specific feedback recorded.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Guardian confirmation includes at least one specific point about what's realistic, or not, for the household.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The plan is revised, or explicitly kept as-is with reasoning, in response to that specific guardian feedback.

lookFors: No real diagnosis, medication, symptom, or account/insurance number appears anywhere in the plan.
Contact entries use role-and-location format consistently across the plan.
Guardian confirmation reflects a real conversation, not just a checked box.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
